detail: Manpreet Singh has submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to the NSE under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, signalling a material change in shareholding in Almondz Global Securities, a listed securities brokerage. Reg 31(4) mandates public disclosure when an acquirer crosses a significant threshold; the disclosure itself does not automatically trigger an open offer unless acquisition has breached the 25% (or relevant) threshold.
